title: Store quantization profiles in model registry with versioning + cached read APIs
creator: Ethan Park
description:
We need to add first-class storage + versioning for Quantization Profile Library artifacts in the Model Registry, and expose read APIs used by control plane + runtime with explicit caching semantics.

Context
- Applied ML will publish a versioned profile per (model_id, variant, quant_method, hardware constraints). Runtime + policy must deterministically resolve a specific version (no silent drift).
- v1 is opt-in at route level; default behavior unchanged when disabled.

Scope
1) Registry data model for profile metadata
- Store profile metadata and schema-validated payload (v1 schema) keyed by (profile_id, version) with:
  - profile_id (stable ID), version (semver-ish string, e.g. "1.0.3"), created_at, created_by, status (draft|published|deprecated|revoked)
  - model_id + variant, quant_method, precision (weights/acts), calibration refs
  - compatibility constraints (gpu_sku_classes, min_driver, max_context, known caveats)
  - content_digest for metadata JSON and artifact_digest for binary artifacts
- Version uniqueness: (profile_id, version) unique; publishing a new version does NOT overwrite prior versions.
- Deprecation: keep prior versions readable; mark deprecated w/ reason + replacement pointer.

2) Artifact storage + integrity
- Store runtime-consumable artifacts (e.g., scales/zero points / kernel params / packing configs) in object storage under a deterministic path:
  - quant-profiles/{profile_id}/{version}/artifact.tar.zst
- Add integrity verification:
  - registry calculates SHA256 digests; store digests in metadata
  - registry signs an artifact manifest (ed25519) so runtime can verify it fetched the intended bytes
- Explicitly document key rotation + verification behavior (runtime refuses on signature mismatch; policy falls back to baseline if a profile cannot be fetched/verified).

3) Read APIs (internal)
Provide stable, cache-friendly endpoints used by:
- Control plane policy engine (compatibility checks + surfacing available profiles)
- Serving runtime (fetching resolved (profile_id, version) artifacts)

Proposed endpoints (internal service-to-service):
- GET /v1/models/{model_id}/variants/{variant}/quantization-profiles
  - Returns list of published profiles + latest versions + compatibility summary (no large artifacts)
- GET /v1/quantization-profiles/{profile_id}/versions/{version}
  - Returns full metadata JSON (schema-validated)
- GET /v1/quantization-profiles/{profile_id}/versions/{version}/artifact
  - Redirect (302) to signed object URL OR stream bytes; must provide digest + signature headers for verification

Caching semantics
- Metadata endpoints:
  - Include ETag based on content_digest
  - Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 for published versions; max-age=30 for "draft" (if ever exposed internally)
  - Support If-None-Match for efficient polling
- Artifact endpoint:
  - Immutable per (profile_id, version); Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400, immutable
  - Strong ETag based on artifact_digest
- Registry must protect itself from thundering herds:
  - local in-process cache for hot metadata reads (LRU) w/ TTL 60s
  - rate-limit per caller identity; return 429 w/ Retry-After

Out of scope
- Write APIs exposed to customers
- Auto-recommendation ("recommended" aliases) and auto-tuning

Acceptance criteria
- Can store and retrieve multiple versions of a profile without overwriting.
- Published versions are immutable (attempted overwrite rejected).
- Read APIs return deterministic metadata for a pinned (profile_id, version).
- ETag/If-None-Match works for metadata endpoints; artifacts are cacheable as immutable.
- Artifact digest + signature verification path implemented and documented.
- Deprecation is represented and surfaced in list endpoint.
- Basic load tests: 1k QPS metadata list reads do not overload registry; cache hit rate measurable.

Implementation notes / decisions
- We will keep profile *version* explicit everywhere; no "latest" resolution inside the registry API. Control plane may choose to present "latest" in UX but must pin to a concrete version when writing route config.
- For v1 we expose only published + deprecated (readable) to callers; revoked versions remain readable only to admins for incident analysis.

Rollout plan
- Land schema-backed storage behind feature flag in registry.
- Backfill sample profiles (Applied ML) for perf-canary + staging.
- Enable internal callers in staging, then prod, before Console beta.

comments: 2025-01-22 (Quentin Harris): Drafted initial storage model. Suggest keeping metadata JSON as validated blob + indexed columns for model_id/variant/status for list queries. Will avoid partial materialization until we know query patterns.
2025-01-24 (Jordan Lee): Determinism note: list endpoint must not reorder/omit based on caller region; recommend stable sort by (profile_id, version). Also: no server-side aliasing for "latest".

2025-01-29 (Marcus Lin): Security review: signing key material must live in KMS. Ensure signed manifest includes: profile_id, version, artifact_digest, created_at, registry_build_id. Runtime should verify all fields match resolution outcome.

2025-02-04 (Benji Okafor): API shape is good. Please include explicit "status" and "deprecated_replaced_by" fields so Console can warn. Also need clear 404 vs 409 behavior: 404 when unknown, 409 when trying to publish an existing (profile_id, version).

2025-02-11 (Quentin Harris): Implemented object path convention and digest headers. Artifact endpoint will 302 to presigned URL for large bytes; metadata endpoint remains direct JSON. Added support for If-None-Match and 304 responses.

2025-02-18 (Connor O'Brien): For rollout, make sure registry cache TTL is independent from Cache-Control headers; we want internal callers to honor 300s but registry still needs protection under incident conditions. Add explicit rate limiting per service token.
2025-03-03 (Quentin Harris): Landed: versioned artifact storage + signing in registry. Next: wire control plane caller to use If-None-Match; runtime will verify signature/digest before apply.

2025-03-18 (Quentin Harris): Closed after prod deploy and perf-canary validation. Observed ~92% 304 rate for metadata polling in staging once control plane started using If-None-Match. No registry CPU spike at 1k QPS in synthetic test.
